dlg.vonnra.first.0.intent: names the toll and sizes you up
dlg.vonnra.first.0.note: Very still. 'A reader.' a verdict. 'The toll is the toll' a ritual phrase. A faint dry amusement in the last sentence.

dlg.vonnra.first.1.intent: the one she has waited for has come
dlg.vonnra.first.1.wants: to hide how much this matters
dlg.vonnra.first.1.note: 'So.' long beat. 'The one from the ford.' as if confirming a delivery. The pause before '...Sooner than I had thought' is the most telling thing she does: almost to herself. Then back to ritual, perfectly level.

dlg.vonnra.first.2.note: The ritual phrase. 'and I remember your face' quietly menacing, unhurried.

dlg.vonnra.hub.1.note: Each sentence its own weight. 'Payment, always.' her refrain, never varied in tone.

dlg.vonnra.hub.0.note: A beat where the name would be. Then as hub.1, but a degree warmer.

dlg.vonnra.hub.2.note: Narrator for the lamp and the south. 'Traveller.' acknowledgement without turning. A quiet prophecy. 'Payment, always.'

dlg.vonnra.paid.0.note: 'Try to come back through it.' neither warning nor kindness; both.

dlg.vonnra.ledger_read.0.note: 'There.' Each sentence a fact laid down. No hint that she knows more.

dlg.vonnra.vault.0.note: 'Not for any price.' immovable. The second sentence almost gracious, which is worse.

dlg.vonnra.arcana.0.note: Say 'Legio Septima' as LEG-ee-oh sep-TEE-mah, crisp and old. 'Ask me something cheaper.' dry.
dlg.vonnra.arcana.0.say: You do read. Then you know what Legio Septima means over a door, and you know better than to ask me what is behind it. Ask me something cheaper.

dlg.vonnra.ford.0.wants: you to wonder, not to know
dlg.vonnra.ford.0.note: Her 'seeing' as sight. 'A light going out at the crossing.' a long pause. 'And then, a little after, another one coming on.' 'It is not often the second thing happens.' almost tender, a secret. Pause. The fee line dry.

dlg.vonnra.fortune.0.wants: to read the result of her work
dlg.vonnra.fortune.0.note: Commands, unhurried. 'No, the other one' precise. 'I have been waiting to see how it came out.' the only hint of appetite in her voice.

dlg.vonnra.f_beasts.0.intent: you broke faith with the Pack
dlg.vonnra.f_beasts.0.note: Seeing, as sight. 'So will I.' very quiet, final.

dlg.vonnra.f_beasts.1.note: The images unhurried. The last sentence a quiet lesson, approving.

dlg.vonnra.f_beasts.2.note: A faint amusement at Holloway. 'Be careful what you have taught them to follow.' a warning.

dlg.vonnra.f_beasts.3.note: Flat images. The last sentence slow and pitiless.

dlg.vonnra.f_beasts.4.note: 'Too quiet.' A pause before the simile.

dlg.vonnra.f_beasts.5.note: 'You were busy. The world was not.' two flat strokes.

dlg.vonnra.f_beasts.6.note: 'Someone always is.' dry. The Wenna line pointed.

dlg.vonnra.f_caravan.0.note: Images; the last clause heavy with consequence.

dlg.vonnra.f_caravan.1.note: Warm images; the last sentence a cool compliment.

dlg.vonnra.f_caravan.4.note: 'I see cages.' Pause. 'You know.' barely voiced.

dlg.vonnra.f_ember.0.note: 'I wonder for what.' genuinely interested, and wary.

dlg.vonnra.f_ember.1.note: 'That is honest. It is not the same thing as good.' a lesson.

dlg.vonnra.f_ember.2.note: 'where nothing will ever buy them' plain. 'That is the first thing you have thrown away that I approve of.' cold, and as near to a compliment as she comes.

dlg.vonnra.f_ember.4.note: 'sold to whoever paid for them first' flat. 'I think you know who that was.' quiet: she does, and so do you.

dlg.vonnra.f_pell.0.note: 'He is still counting.' A hint of pity, none of mercy.

dlg.vonnra.f_pell.1.note: Dry about his protests. 'They are not in this town.' ominous.

dlg.vonnra.f_pell.3.note: 'He took his books with him.' plain. 'You are in them.' quiet: the warning is in the last four words.

dlg.vonnra.f_pell.4.note: 'One day he will count you.' quiet.

dlg.vonnra.f_self.0.wants: to hide that she knows exactly what
dlg.vonnra.f_self.0.note: 'And you.' A beat. The middle sentence a wry understatement. 'I would very much like to know what.' a lie, smoothly told.

dlg.vonnra.f_self.1.note: 'It is not flattering.' the driest line she has.

dlg.vonnra.f_self.3.note: Her secret almost surfacing. 'and the lamps lit for you' too gentle. The last sentence a held breath.

dlg.vonnra.f_past.0.intent: quotes what you said in Sella's bed
dlg.vonnra.f_past.0.note: She is reciting something bought, but makes it sound like sight. Narrator: she is not looking at your palm.

dlg.vonnra.f_past.1.intent: quotes what you said in Sella's bed

dlg.vonnra.f_past.2.intent: quotes what you said in Sella's bed

dlg.vonnra.f_past.3.intent: quotes what you said in Sella's bed

dlg.vonnra.f_below.0.note: The deepest reading. Unhurried images; 'they think it will be grateful' with pity. Trails off on the door, deliberately.

dlg.vonnra.f_door.0.intent: closes the reading, using your name
dlg.vonnra.f_door.0.note: 'is listening, as I am' very quiet. A beat where the name would be. The last sentence certain, almost fond.

dlg.vonnra.f_door.1.note: The last sentence certain, almost fond.

dlg.vonnra.f_accuse.0.emo: listening very hard, caught for once
dlg.vonnra.f_accuse.0.intent: accused, she answers with your name
dlg.vonnra.f_accuse.0.wants: you to sit and hear the rest
dlg.vonnra.f_accuse.0.note: The narrator holds the long look. Not denial, not admission. A breath before 'Sit down' (she is alive, and it is cold). The name is spliced in at the pause, its own take in her voice: the only warmth anywhere in her part, and it should frighten. 'I have not finished reading.' quietly in command. Never 'traveller'.
dlg.vonnra.f_accuse.0.beats: [breath] ...Sit down. | I have not finished reading.

dlg.vonnra.cb_opened_vault.0.note: 'You opened it.' A long pause, the closest she comes to fear. Then sharp control: she would rather you stood. The question urgent under the calm.

dlg.vonnra.cb_vault2.0.note: 'Then it is still there.' Repeat 'that is all' exactly the same both times; the repetition is the tell.

dlg.vonnra.cb_vault3.0.note: 'Yours, for now.' cool. Then quiet menace. 'You will find I collect.' softly.

dlg.vonnra.cb_core_stolen.0.note: Each word placed. 'I am not angry.' A beat. 'I am arranging.' the coldest line in the act.

dlg.vonnra.cb_exposed_pell.0.note: Dry; the last sentence calculating, faintly threatening.

dlg.vonnra.say_calling.0.note: Three nouns, unhurried. 'It is a lovely belief.' kind and pitying.

dlg.vonnra.say_calling.2.note: 'Some of them keep ledgers.' a real warning.

dlg.vonnra.coin.0.note: Old-empire, square: fingering it. Lineage, quiet pride. 'something that cannot be bought twice' almost a confession. Pause. Then dry: 'Do not grow used to it.'

dlg.vonnra.risen.0.note: 'You came back.' Long pause. Firm instructions. 'you will find out who holds the note' very quiet, very sure.

dlg.vonnra.jessop.0.note: Unruffled. Narrator: the page that does not need turning. The last line a quiet, chilling aphorism.
